sentence: RE1-OB from RCAEval (Pham et al., WWW 2025), 125 labelled failures from the Online Boutique microservice system
published_baselines_note: arXiv 2412.17015 has no RE1-OB results table (only Table 6, RE2 Train Ticket).
data_notes: Label check: cases.parquet root_cause_service equals the service in the directory name for 50 of 50 cases.
Columns `PassthroughCluster_*` are not fed to the engine, present in 20 cases. Reason: Istio's catch-all cluster for traffic to unknown destinations, not a service.
Columns `main_*` are not fed to the engine, present in all 50 cases. Reason: the loadgenerator container (Locust traffic client, kubernetes-manifests/loadgenerator.yaml).
Every other column is used, with its original name as the event name.
Null cells (metric not observed at that second, skipped, no fill): 4238.
